title: One-bit $(p,2)$-hypercontractivity
statement:
Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^1\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function on a single bit, and let $p$ be a real number with $1\le p\le 2$. Suppose $\rho\ge 0$ satisfies $\rho^2\le p-1$. Writing $T_\rho$ for the noise operator and $\E$ for expectation under the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^1$,
\[
  \big(\E\big[(T_\rho f)^2\big]\big)^{1/2}\;\le\;\big(\E\big[|f|^p\big]\big)^{1/p}.
\]
replaced:
For $f : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,1 \to \bbr$, $1 \le p \le 2$, and $\rho \ge 0$ with
$\rho^2 \le p-1$,
\[
  \big(\E[(T_\rho f)^2]\big)^{1/2} \le \big(\E[|f|^p]\big)^{1/p}.
\]
